jobs.title: Lab Automation Lead
jobs.description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. jobs.title: Founding engineer- Mo team (AI Health Companion)
jobs.description: 🤖 Who we are We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone. We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖. We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. 🚀 What keeps us up at night We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale . You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise . Our mission is to build the most accurate and reliable medical agent in the world , while delivering an outstanding conversational experience . Things we’re working on: 💬 Deliver the most memorable chatting experience — You’ll work on making Mo the obvious choice when it comes to asking a health question. It means having a world-class snappy and delightful chatting experience, blazing fast time to answer, and rich content shared. 🧱 Integrate Mo with Alan services and our healthcare system — You’ll work on integrating Mo with our other services (digital chat with HP, map of physical location of HPs, tailored prevention programs, …) to help members get from words to actions. ➕ Extend our architecture to support the next chapters of Mo — You’ll work on our architecture, and agentic framework, to support Mo’s next needs (get more context, use new skills, be accessible in other countries we operate in) If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey. jobs.description: Â POSITION SUMMARY: Job Function: Clinical Operations Title: Senior Clinical Trial Systems Lead The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead serves as the business owner representative for Clinical Operations systems, such as CTMS and eTMF. This role defines business problems and intended use, facilitates the prioritization for system updates and enhancements, coordinates handoff to IT and product partners, reviews designs and prototypes iteratively, and coordinates user acceptance testing and go-live approval. This individual will work in partnership with IS&T, Product, UI/UX, QA, Training, and the vendors who design, build, and validate outsourced systems. The role is also the day-to-day business point of contact for users and cross-functional teams, supporting troubleshooting, and continuous system improvements. The Senior Clinical Trials Systems Lead helps ensure that systems meet the requirements of study protocols, regulatory standards, business objectives, and user needs, and are fit for their intended use. Support system compliance with FDA, EMA, and ICH-GCP standards by defining GxP impact for all changes. Work closely with IS&T, QA, and product teams to manage system integrations, upgrades, and vendor service levels. Document stakeholder requirements clearly, identify process gaps, and propose actionable solutions. Review system designs and prototypes iteratively, providing fast, direct feedback. Coordinate and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), documenting results to provide final business sign-off. Serve as the primary functional support contact for internal teams, troubleshooting issues and escalating technical blockers to IS&T. jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options. Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time. You won’t do it alone.
